description: Get the top-ranked engineering articles (default Top 10) from the alekseialeinikov.com leaderboard, ranked by verified 30-day or 7-day readership and AI tool lookups. Use this whenever a user asks for the most-read, popular, trending, or top 10 articles rather than keyword search. Supports optional language ("en" default, or "de"), period ("30d" default, or "7d"), topic pillar filter, and limit (1-15, default 10). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language edition for returned articles and leaderboard URL ("en" default, or "de").

limit.description: Number of top articles to return (1-15, default 10).

period.description: Ranking window: "30d" (30-day chart, default) or "7d" (weekly trending).

name: get_top_articles
